selector.rationale: Schwannoma best explains the findings due to its high score and lack of contradictions, with features like the lobulated mass at the cerebellopontine angle and extension into the infratemporal fossa via the foramen ovale being consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chordoma
rejected.why: Lower score and less specific evidence

rejected.label: Hemangioblastoma
rejected.why: Less consistent with the described location and imaging characteristics

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: While possible, the specific features and higher score of Schwannoma make it a more likely diagnosis
